name: Bundle of Wood
summary: Eastvale Logging Camp needs wood sent west for Stormwind's rebuilding.

sections.title: Abandoned Timber
sections.body: Eastvale Logging Camp sends freshly chopped timber west for buildings and other construction in the Kingdom of Stormwind. But bears and wolves have entered the groves northwest of camp. The frightened loggers fled, leaving their Bundles of Wood among the trees. With the shipment deadline near, overseer Raelen needs travelers to recover the timber before the lumber contracts are breached.

faq.q: Why were these bundles of wood abandoned in the woods?
faq.answer: Wolves and bears drove off the loggers harvesting timber northwest of Eastvale Logging Camp. The workers left their freshly chopped Bundles of Wood on the forest floor.
Raelen, an overseer at Eastvale Logging Camp, needs the wood gathered soon to meet an approaching lumber shipment deadline.
The bundles lie among the trees directly northwest of Eastvale Logging Camp, where Elwynn's bears and wolves prowl.

faq.q: Why didn't the town guards clear out the beasts?
faq.answer: Raelen asked Deputy Rainer for help, but Elwynn's marshals and guards are stretched thin across the region. The lumber workers need outside help to recover the logs quickly.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, gathering the bundles helps Stormwind rebuild and keeps vital timber shipments on time for settlements across Elwynn and Westfall.
